policy: Use the application project.pbxproj ZIP entry modification date as a catalog-date proxy, at the maintainer’s direction on 2026-11-10. Existing day-precision records are unchanged. Require consistency with the existing date interval and neighboring versions within the same major release series; compare adjacent new candidates as well. Older .xcode and .pbproj Project Builder containers are included. ZIP hashes are verified against manifest.json. Rejected candidates are retained here, not displayed as dates.
